name: Le Meridien Lav, Split
insider_take: This sophisticated beachfront resort sits on the stunning Dalmatian coast, where ancient Roman history meets modern luxury just minutes from UNESCO-listed Diocletian's Palace.
whats_special: Le Meridien Lav occupies a prime position on Podstrana's pristine pebble beaches, featuring Croatia's largest spa and wellness center. The property boasts direct access to crystal-clear Adriatic waters and offers panoramic views of the nearby islands of Bra? and Hvar. Its contemporary design incorporates local Bra? stone, connecting guests to the region's rich quarrying heritage.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunrise views over the Adriatic, and time your visit during the ultra-violet festival season when Split transforms into Croatia's electronic music capital.
dont_miss: Take the short journey to explore Diocletian's Palace in Split's old town - one of the world's most impressive Roman monuments where people still live and work within ancient walls. The nearby Cetina River offers thrilling white-water rafting, while the charming fishing village of Omiš, nestled between dramatic limestone cliffs, provides authentic Dalmatian cuisine and medieval pirate history.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with direct access to pristine Adriatic coastline
Modern luxury resort with contemporary Croatian design and premium amenities
Multiple dining options featuring Mediterranean cuisine and local specialties
Full-service spa and wellness center with outdoor pools and fitness facilities
cons: Located in Podstrana, requiring transport to reach Split city center
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and beachfront location
